Titles.eng: I Saved Myself with a Potion!: Life in Another World
Titles.jpn: ポーション、わが身を助ける

Summaries.eng: Kaede, an ordinary high school girl, wakes up in an unfamiliar alleyway. It is a mysterious another filled with beastmen, elves, and dragons. Kaede noticed an unfamiliar book in the backpack she was carrying. It was a mysterious book that could create potions simply by chanting the word “creation”! For Kaede, who had been thrust into this another world, the potions she created became the sustenance that supported her life. While hoping to one day return to Japan, her struggles in this another world continue—.
Summaries.jpn: 普通の女子高生・カエデは、見覚えのない路地裏で目を覚ました。そこは獣人やエルフ、ドラゴンのいる不思議な異世界。カエデは持っていたリュックサックに見覚えのない本があることに気がつく。それは「生成」と唱えるだけでポーションが出来てしまう不思議な本だった！異世界に放り出されたカエデにとって、生成されたポーションは生活を支える糧になった。いつか日本へ帰ることを望みながら女子高生の異世界での奮闘は続いていく―

Aliases: I Saved Myself with a Potion!: Life in Another World

Titles.eng: I Saved Myself with a Potion!: Life in Another World

Summaries.eng: Kaede, a high school girl who wakes up in a fantasy world with a book that lets her create potions. Season 1 follows her as she uses her unique ability to sell potions for survival, interact with various characters like a dragon hunter and an elf, and try to make a stable life for herself.

Kaede, an ordinary high school girl, wakes up in a strange world and finds a book she doesn't recognize. The book says that she can make a potion by simply gathering the ingredients and chanting "create."
Summaries.jpn: 見覚えのない異世界で目を覚ました普通の女子高生・カエデの元には見覚えのない本が。そこには材料を揃えて「生成」と唱えるだけでポーションが作れると書いてあり――

Summaries.eng: Kaede has successfully secured food and lodging by selling the potions she created. While searching for a bag large enough to hold more potions, she comes across an especially expensive bag...!?
Summaries.jpn: 生成したポーションを売って、食事と宿を確保することに成功したカエデ。大量のポーションを作るため、もっと入るカバンを探しているとひときわ高いカバンがあり……!?

Summaries.eng: Wanting to create a large amount of potions without being seen, Kaede comes up with the idea of ​​creating them in a river outside the city. When Kaede makes a request at the guild, a man and woman named Sherry and Ranji appear before her...!?
Summaries.jpn: 人目につかず大量のポーションを作りたいと考えたカエデは、街の外の川で生成することを思いつく。ギルドで依頼を出したカエデのもとにセリーとランジという男女が現れて――!?

Summaries.eng: With the encouragement of the pharmacist, Kaede decides to open a stall and sell potions. Kaede is about to start the stall right away, but then Sherry shows up...
Summaries.jpn: 薬屋のすすめもあり、自分で露店を開いてポーションを売ることにしたカエデ。早速露店を始めようとするカエデだが、そこにセリーが現れて――？

Summaries.eng: A group of dragon hunters suddenly appears. They say they want to meet the creator of Kaede's potion. One of the dragon hunters, a slightly unsociable elf, has a special constitution...
Summaries.jpn: 突如現れたドラゴンハンターの一行。カエデのポーションの製作者に会いたいのだという。ドラゴンハンターの一人、少し不愛想なエルフには特殊な体質があり――？

Summaries.eng:
Kaede has some time before her appointment with Asuru, and she becomes interested in the new "crystal stone" that has been added to her recipe book.

She stops by a magic stone shop to buy some ingredients, and meets a dragon woman, but...
Summaries.jpn: アスルとの約束まで時間があるカエデはレシピ本に新しく追加された「晶石」に興味を持つ。材料を買うために立ち寄った魔法石屋で龍族の女性に出会うが――？

Summaries.eng: Kaede's achievements in slaying a dragon have been recognized, and she comes to the royal capital with Asuru and the others. Ray, the leader of the Dragon Hunters, takes a liking to her, and introduces her to an acquaintance who is selling a house.
Summaries.jpn: ドラゴン退治の功績が認められ、アスル達とともに王都にやってきたカエデ。ドラゴンハンターのリーダーでもあるレイに気に入られ、家を売っているという知り合いを紹介してもらうことになる。

Summaries.eng: Kaede has finally purchased her dream home, but it turns out that a fairy named Nina has also taken up residence in the house. Kaede has become friends with Nina and even set up a stall in the royal capital, and life in her new place seems to be off to a good start...
Summaries.jpn: 念願だった自分の家を購入したカエデだが購入した家には妖精のニナも住み着いていた。ニナと友達になったり、王都でも露店を始めたりと、新しい土地での生活も順調に始まったかのように見えるカエデだったが……

Summaries.eng: Kaede has been attacked by robbers who are after the money she earns from her street stall. As a countermeasure, Rei encourages her to buy a slave for her own safety. Kaede doesn't approve of slavery and is reluctant to do so, so she decides to hire a bodyguard for the time being, but...
Summaries.jpn: 露店で稼いだお金を狙われ、強盗に襲われるようになったカエデ。対策として、身の安全のために奴隷を買うようにレイに進められる。奴隷にいいイメージがなく、どうしても気が進まないカエデは、しばらくは護衛を雇うことにするのだが――

Summaries.eng: After meeting a werewolf slave named Karudeno, Kaede heads into the forest to gather ingredients for a High Potion. With Karudeno's help as her escort, Kaede and her friends make good progress deeper into the forest, but then they come across a trio being chased by a wild boar.
Summaries.jpn: 狼族の奴隷、カルデノと出会ったカエデは、ハイポーションの材料を集めるために森へ向かう。カルデノの護衛もあって順調に森の奥へ進むカエデたちだが、そんな二人の前にイノシシに追われている三人組が現れる。

Summaries.eng: Kaede is asked by Rei to make a High Potion. But Karudeno is not happy with Rei's attitude. Meanwhile, the three brothers are reluctant to give up on the fairy fountain and ask Kaede to go into the forest with them.
Summaries.jpn: レイの依頼でハイポーションを作ることになったカエデ。一方カルデノは、レイの態度が気に入らないという。そんな中、妖精の泉を諦めきれない三兄弟に一緒に森に行ってくれないかと頼まれる。

Summaries.eng: The moment they thought they had reached the fairy fountain, Gita was swallowed by a monster. Before they could even think about Gita's safety, Kaede and the others were attacked by the monster. They fought back with Kaede's crystal and it seemed they had defeated it, but...
Summaries.jpn: 妖精の泉についたと思った瞬間、ギトが魔物に飲み込まれてしまう。ギトの身を案じる間もなく魔物に襲われるカエデたち。カエデの晶石で反撃し、一度は倒したかに思われたが――？
